### NETSCOUT Reports Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/726993193/files/doc_news/NETSCOUT-Reports-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2027-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


*Delivers Second Quarter Results in Line with Expectations;* *Reaffirms Full Year Outlook*


WESTFORD, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection, announced financial results for its second quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Remarks by Anil Singhal, NETSCOUT’s President & Chief Executive Officer:**


“Our second-quarter results were consistent with our expectations, and our first half performance keeps us on track for fiscal year 2027. As anticipated, government-related orders that benefited the first quarter shaped our second quarter comparison. Our continued focus on cost discipline drove operating margin expansion from the prior year, and we repurchased approximately $77 million of common stock during the quarter, reflecting our commitment to shareholder returns. We are reaffirming our full-year outlook as we continue to execute on our strategy to drive revenue growth, expand margins, and generate solid free cash flow.


“At our ENGAGE Annual User and Technology Summit in October, we showcased our newest solutions and capabilities to an enthusiastic audience of more than 400 customers and partners. These solutions extend our Scalable DPI derived, AI-Ready Smart Data into AIOps and agentic workflows. Our customers are in the early phases of their AI journey, and we view this as a multi-year opportunity rather than a near-term cycle. As their investment matures, NETSCOUT’s role as a trusted data source for network observability, AI, and cybersecurity, positions us to expand within our installed base, capture new opportunities, and drive long-term growth.”


**Second Quarter Financial Results: FY2027 compared with FY2026**


- Total revenue grew 1.4% to $222.2 million, compared with $219.0 million.


- Product revenue decreased 5.1% to $89.9 million, or 40% of total revenue, compared with $94.7 million, or 43%. As of September 30, 2026, total product backlog was $20.9 million, including $15.4 million of fulfillable backlog, compared with $39.8 million and $27.7 million, respectively.
- Service revenue increased 6.4% to $132.3 million, or 60% of total revenue, compared with $124.3 million, or 57%.


- GAAP income from operations was $37.6 million, or 16.9% of total revenue, compared with $32.5 million, or 14.8% of total revenue.
- Non-GAAP income from operations was $62.9 million, or 28.3% of total revenue, compared with $58.1 million, or 26.5%.
- GAAP net income was $34.4 million, or $0.47 per diluted share, compared with $25.8 million,
or $0.35 per diluted share.
- Non-GAAP net income was $52.8 million, or $0.71 per diluted share, compared with $45.1 million, or
$0.62 per diluted share.
- Adjusted EBITDA was $66.5 million, or 29.9 % of total revenue, compared with $60.7 million, or 27.7 %.
- A reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP results is included in the financial tables below.


During the second quarter, NETSCOUT repurchased 2.0 million shares of its common stock for approximately $77 million. As of September 30, 2026, cash, cash equivalents, and short and long-term marketable securities totaled $571.3 million, compared with $705.1 million as of March 31, 2026. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had no debt outstanding under its $600 million revolving credit facility, which expires in October 2029.


**First-Half Financial Results: FY2027 compared with FY2026**


- Total revenue increased 6.6% to $432.6 million, compared with $405.8 million.


- Product revenue increased 4.9% to $175.9 million, or 41% of total revenue, compared with $167.7 million, or 41%.
- Service revenue increased 7.8% to $256.7 million, or 59% of total revenue, compared with $238.1 million, or 59%.


- GAAP income from operations was $52.1 million, or 12.0% of total revenue, compared with
$25.9 million, or 6.4% of total revenue.
- Non-GAAP income from operations was $106.6 million, or 24.6% of total revenue, compared with
$84.6 million, or 20.9%.
- GAAP net income was $56.2 million, or $0.76 per diluted share, compared with $22.1 million,
or $0.30 per diluted share.
- Non-GAAP net income was $91.3 million, or $1.23 per diluted share, compared with $69.8 million, or
$0.95 per diluted share.
- Adjusted EBITDA was $113.4 million, or 26.2 % of total revenue, compared with $90.0 million,
or 22.2 %.


A reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP results is included in the financial tables below.


**Financial Outlook**


For fiscal year 2027, NETSCOUT is reaffirming its outlook, reflecting anticipated continued growth and margin expansion:


- Revenue to range from $885.0 million to $915.0 million, implying 4.7% year-over-year growth at the midpoint;
- GAAP net income per diluted share to range from $1.55 to $1.70; and
- Non-GAAP net income per diluted share to range from $2.65 to $2.80, implying 9.9% year-over-year growth at the midpoint.
- A reconciliation between GAAP and non-GAAP fiscal year 2027 outlook is in the financial tables below.


**Recent Developments and Highlights**


- October: Released NETSCOUT’s “Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) Threat Intelligence Report, Issue 17: Findings from H1 2026,” revealing a significant shift in how attacks are launched and sourced with growth in three areas: the volume of traffic that must be inspected, the number of places where mitigation must be deployed, and the share of attacks that disrupt service without ever saturating a link.
- October: Hosted highly successful ENGAGE 2026 attended by over 400 customers and partners from more than 30 countries. The annual technology and user summit focused on advances in AI-Ready Smart Data solutions, enabling customers to approach AI more strategically in their network and decision making.
- September: Unveiled nGenius Copilot, an AI-powered conversational extension to nGeniusONE® that provides intuitive access to NETSCOUT’s AI-Ready Smart Data, giving more users easier and faster ways to investigate service disruptions and assess business impact.
- September: Launched MCP connectivity for its Omnis AI Insights solution to provide AI assistants and agents on-demand access to AI-Ready Smart Data, NETSCOUT’s real-time operational evidence to deliver the trusted context they need to support more accurate and informed decisions.
- September: Expanded the data platform to provide the trusted operational context required to build the foundation for enterprise AI that can transform AI-driven network operations by dramatically improving MTTK and controls costs by reducing AI token consumption.
- August: Enhanced Arbor Edge Defense (AED) solution that helps enterprises safeguard essential services by maintaining the availability of revenue-generating and mission-critical applications against sophisticated DDoS attacks that evade or bypass content delivery network (CDN) DDoS defenses.
- August: Extended Adaptive DDoS Protection (ADP) solution enabling service providers to automatically detect and mitigate outbound DDoS attack traffic, helping operators prevent compromised subscriber devices from disrupting their own networks, consuming costly capacity and attacking customers and organizations across the internet.

**Use of Non-GAAP Financial Information:**


To supplement the financial measures presented in NETSCOUT's press release in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (GAAP), NETSCOUT also reports the following non-GAAP measures: non-GAAP gross profit, non-GAAP income from operations, non-GAAP operating margin, non-GAAP net income, non-GAAP net income per diluted share, and adjusted EBITDA. Non-GAAP gross profit removes expenses related to the amortization of acquired intangible assets and share-based compensation expense from gross profit (GAAP). Non-GAAP income from operations includes the aforementioned adjustments related to non-GAAP gross profit and also removes executive transition costs, and restructuring charges from income from operations (GAAP). Non-GAAP operating margin is non-GAAP income from operations expressed as a percentage of revenue. Non-GAAP net income includes the foregoing adjustments related to non-GAAP income from operations and also removes the income tax effects of such adjustments from net income (GAAP). Non-GAAP net income per diluted share is non-GAAP net income divided by total outstanding shares on a diluted basis. Adjusted EBITDA includes the aforementioned adjustments related to non-GAAP net income and also removes interest and other expense, income tax expense, and depreciation and amortization from net income (GAAP). Beginning in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, we have renamed non-GAAP EBITDA from operations to adjusted EBITDA. Investors are encouraged to review the related GAAP financial measures and the reconciliation of these non-GAAP financial measures to their most directly comparable GAAP financial measures included in the attached tables within this press release. Beginning with the three months ended September 30, 2026, we revised our definitions of non-GAAP gross profit, non-GAAP income from operations, non-GAAP net income, and adjusted EBITDA to no longer adjust for acquisition-related depreciation expense, as such amounts are not currently material. We may adjust for acquisition-related depreciation expense in future periods if such amounts become material. The change does not impact our financial position, cash flows, or GAAP consolidated results of operations. Prior-period non-GAAP financial measures presented have been recast to conform to the current presentation.


These non-GAAP measures are not prepared in accordance with GAAP, should not be considered an alternative for measures prepared in accordance with GAAP (gross profit, income from operations, operating margin, net income, and net income per diluted share), and may have limitations because they do not reflect all NETSCOUT’s results of operations as determined in accordance with GAAP. These non-GAAP measures should only be used to evaluate NETSCOUT’s results of operations in conjunction with the corresponding GAAP measures. The presentation of non-GAAP information is not meant to be considered superior to, in isolation from, or as a substitute for results prepared in accordance with GAAP. NETSCOUT believes these non-GAAP financial measures will enhance the reader’s overall understanding of NETSCOUT’s current financial performance and NETSCOUT's prospects for the future by providing a higher degree of transparency for certain financial measures and providing a level of disclosure that helps investors understand how the Company plans and measures its own business. NETSCOUT believes that providing these non-GAAP measures affords investors a view of NETSCOUT’s operating results that may be more easily compared to peer companies and also enables investors to consider NETSCOUT’s operating results on both a GAAP and non-GAAP basis during and following the integration period of NETSCOUT’s acquisitions. Presenting the GAAP measures on their own, without the supplemental non-GAAP disclosures, might not be indicative of NETSCOUT’s core operating results. Furthermore, NETSCOUT believes that the presentation of non-GAAP measures when shown in conjunction with the corresponding GAAP measures provides useful information to management and investors regarding present and future business trends relating to its financial condition and results of operations.


NETSCOUT management regularly uses supplemental non-GAAP financial measures internally to understand, manage and evaluate its business and to make operating decisions. These non-GAAP measures are among the primary factors that management uses in planning and forecasting.


**About NETSCOUT**


NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT) protects the connected world from cyberattacks and performance and availability disruptions through its unique visibility platform and solutions powered by its pioneering deep packet inspection at scale technology. As a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack protection solutions, NETSCOUT serves the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and public sector organizations. Learn more at[www.netscout.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.netscout.com&esheet=54635240&newsitemid=20261105439410&lan=en-US&anchor=www.netscout.com&index=2&md5=4b0f341bcfcd73d17daa99a8a3effbfa) or follow @NETSCOUT on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnetscout%2Fhome%2F&esheet=54635240&newsitemid=20261105439410&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=3&md5=ff354286e01bc26f9e667d8532e54776) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNETSCOUT%3Flang%3Den&esheet=54635240&newsitemid=20261105439410&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=4&md5=490610004d4be32fe553b842753b9baf) , or[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fnetscoutinc%2F&esheet=54635240&newsitemid=20261105439410&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=5&md5=95dbf3d8f70e0ab48efc0b915d878de0) .
